dedupe_keys.name: tsms drone synchronised radar and radio sensing

description: TSMS-Drone publishes synchronised measurements from frequency-modulated continuous-wave radar, continuous-wave radar and a radio-frequency receiver for detecting drones. The research team provides raw signals and processed range-Doppler, Doppler-spectrum and power-spectral representations from four commercial drone types and a non-drone target. Controlled measurements span two to thirty metres in two-metre increments with repeated trials. Figshare distributes measurement packages and MATLAB processing examples under CC BY 4.0 at no charge. Coverage is the controlled test arrangement; the own metadata does not specify the full acquisition calendar or a common sampling rate across all sensing modalities. These observations can calibrate sensor fusion and detection models for infrastructure monitoring or protection, and complement wireless modelling studies involving model-vienna-5g-simulators. A caveat is that short-range controlled trials do not establish performance across real airports, weather conditions or other target classes. Several package names repeat in the repository inventory, so users should preserve the provider's complete file paths when assembling the release.
